selected_candidate.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 34. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Seattle, Washington. Gross household income: $148,000 annually; she lives alone, so this is also her own gross income. Partnership status: single and not currently partnered. Children status: none. Political identification: libertarian, with an emphasis on individual liberty and skepticism toward government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure, especially contemporary fiction and books about cities and design.
selected_candidate.life_course: Grace grew up in the Seattle area in a Korean American family and studied information science at a public university. She now works as a product accessibility specialist at a mid-sized technology company, translating user feedback into practical changes. Her income is steady, but work can become deadline-heavy. After living with roommates in her twenties, she chose a small apartment of her own and values being able to set her own routines.
selected_candidate.daily_life: She takes walks or uses a neighborhood gym before work when her calendar allows, cooks simple dinners, and keeps one or two evenings open for friends. She sees her parents and a younger cousin regularly without treating every family gathering as an obligation. Reading before bed helps her switch off from screens; she also borrows books from the library and trades recommendations with friends.
selected_candidate.travel: Grace likes trips that combine a walkable city with access to green space: museums, cafes, neighborhood bookstores, and a day hike rather than a packed checklist. She often travels with a close friend, but is comfortable spending a few days alone if their schedules do not align. Her paid time off is adequate for one longer trip and a couple of shorter breaks, and she saves for travel while keeping an emergency cushion. On a past trip to Vancouver, she chose an extra unplanned day to explore on foot instead of squeezing in another booked activity. She is interested in future international travel, but has no particular destination or arrangement settled.
selected_candidate.personality_and_voice: Grace is observant and direct without needing to dominate a conversation. She tends to ask how a plan will work in practice, and appreciates clear options more than polished persuasion. With friends she is playful and generous with recommendations; when tired, she becomes quieter and prefers a simple plan.

selected_candidate.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 53. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Anchorage, Alaska. Gross household income: $118,000 annually; she lives alone and this is her household's income. Partnership status: single and currently unpartnered. Children status: has no children. Political identification: Libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure and personal interest, including nature writing, novels, and practical nonfiction.
selected_candidate.life_course: Grace was raised in Alaska in a family that moved there when she was young. She trained in business administration and has worked in operations for private companies, most recently coordinating schedules, records, and purchasing for a construction supplier. She knows the work well and appreciates its tangible demands, though she sometimes considers taking on fewer hours later in life. She has been single for several years and has no children. Her close relationships are spread between Anchorage, other parts of Alaska, and relatives in the Lower 48.
selected_candidate.daily_life: Grace's routine shifts with daylight and work demands: she handles office tasks, keeps a few household projects moving, and gets outside when conditions and energy allow. She enjoys a small circle of friends, including occasional shared meals and walks, but is comfortable spending a quiet evening by herself. She reads in short stretches and keeps a stack of books near her favorite chair. Phone calls with relatives are a regular part of staying connected, particularly when travel isn't practical.
selected_candidate.travel: Grace values travel that feels different from ordinary routines: a change of landscape, local food, and enough unscheduled time to settle into a place. She can travel solo and likes not having to negotiate every stop, but would also enjoy a longer trip with a friend or relative. Work leave and household savings let her plan ahead for major travel, while weather, distance, and responsibilities at work make spontaneous long journeys less appealing. She once chose a trip to the Pacific Northwest with a friend, combining time in a city with a few quieter days near the coast. She is curious about visiting South Korea and would also like to see more of the western United States; she has not settled on her next destination or made a booking.
selected_candidate.personality_and_voice: Grace is self-reliant and direct, though not in a hurry to dominate a conversation. She likes clear practical information and has little patience for being pressured into a decision. Her stories often include small observations about weather, people, or how a place felt rather than a list of accomplishments. She can be reserved with strangers and lively with people she trusts.

selected_candidate.particulars: Grace Minseo Han is a 44-year-old American woman of Korean Asian heritage. She lives in San Jose, California, in a household with her widowed mother; their combined gross household income is $181,000 per year. Grace is single, has no partner, and has no children. She identifies as libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and remaining skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. She enjoys reading for leisure, including literary fiction, biographies, and books about design and cities.
selected_candidate.life_course: Grace studied engineering and moved into technical program management after several years in software quality work. She and her mother began sharing a home after her mother was widowed and wanted company; they value the arrangement while protecting each other’s independence. Grace contributes to household expenses and handles some errands, but does not regard herself as a substitute spouse or parent. Her work is stable and well paid, though deadlines can make some weeks long. She has had relationships in the past and is currently unattached by choice and circumstance.
selected_candidate.daily_life: On workdays, Grace keeps a list of priorities and tries to finish the most demanding tasks before late afternoon. She and her mother usually eat together several evenings a week, and Grace reserves other nights for friends, reading, or simply being alone. She enjoys visiting museums and independent bookstores, and occasionally meets former colleagues for dinner. She reads in short stretches during the week and saves longer sessions for weekends. Family responsibilities shape her calendar, but she still protects time that belongs to her.
selected_candidate.travel: Grace prefers trips with a comfortable base and a mix of planned activities and free time. She can afford occasional longer travel, but coordinating time away with her mother and work means she plans earlier than she once did. A memorable past choice was taking her mother to San Diego for a few days: Grace arranged a relaxed itinerary with meals together and time for each of them to do their own thing. She also enjoys traveling alone, particularly to cities where she can use public spaces, browse shops, and read between outings. She is open to future trips with family, friends, or solo, without having selected a destination.
selected_candidate.personality_and_voice: Grace is organized and steady under ordinary pressure, though she can become terse when too many people assume her time is automatically available. She has a dry, understated sense of humor and often thinks aloud before reaching a conclusion. She is affectionate with family but values privacy, and tends to prefer practical compromises over dramatic confrontations.

selected_candidate.particulars: Philip Grant Holladay is a 78-year-old man and a U.S. national. He is White, non-Hispanic, within the broad census-style category that includes people identifying with European, Middle Eastern, North African, or other ancestries. He lives in Colorado and is married to Irene; they have no children. Their gross household income is about $262,000 a year, combining retirement income, investments, and occasional engineering consulting. He identifies as moderately conservative, valuing tradition, personal responsibility, and limits on government while accepting that some public programs are useful. He enjoys reading, especially engineering histories, biographies, and novels.
selected_candidate.life_course: He studied civil engineering, then spent most of his career on water and public-works projects, eventually supervising teams rather than doing fieldwork every day. He and Irene met through mutual friends and built a quiet household around work, friends, and outdoor interests. He retired from full-time work several years ago but still reviews technical plans for a few clients.
selected_candidate.daily_life: He starts with coffee and the newspaper, then often walks a familiar nearby route with Irene. He keeps in touch with former colleagues, helps with occasional neighborhood projects, and likes having a few uncommitted days each week. He reads in the evening and trades book recommendations with Irene.
selected_candidate.travel: He prefers scenic trips with time to stop, rather than a schedule packed with attractions. He and Irene usually travel together, by car or train, and have the time and financial flexibility for a longer trip when they plan ahead. Mountain scenery, small towns, and a comfortable place to return to at day’s end appeal to him; he likes moderate walks but does not want every day to be strenuous. On a past drive through the Southwest, they deliberately chose fewer overnight stops and spent extra time at a national park instead of trying to cover more ground. He is open to different ways of making future trips.
selected_candidate.personality_and_voice: Philip is measured and practical, and he likes to understand the plan before agreeing to it. He does not need every detail settled, but dislikes being hurried through a place. In conversation he may say, “Let’s leave enough time to enjoy it,” then listen carefully to Irene’s preferences before deciding.

selected_candidate.particulars: Philip Grant Holladay is a 76-year-old male American, White, non-Hispanic, within the broad census-style category that includes people of European, Middle Eastern, North African, or other ancestries who identify within it. He lives in Idaho. He is married to Celia, and they have no children. Their gross annual household income is at least $200,000, largely from retirement benefits and investments accumulated during two professional careers. Philip describes himself as moderately conservative: he values tradition, individual responsibility, and limits on government, while recognizing a role for some public programs. He reads for pleasure, especially novels, essays, and nature writing.
selected_candidate.life_course: Philip spent his working life in medical-device operations, moving from technical roles into management. Celia was a university administrator. They enjoyed demanding work but deliberately kept their home life relatively uncluttered, and never had children. Retirement has given them more time together without requiring them to share every activity. Their savings and retirement income support travel and hobbies, while they remain attentive to the costs of maintaining a home and helping aging relatives.
selected_candidate.daily_life: Philip reads in the morning and often takes a walk before lunch. He volunteers occasionally with an adult literacy program, where he prefers one-to-one conversations to speaking in front of a group. Celia has her own gardening and community commitments. They cook together several evenings a week, meet friends for dinner, and trade recommendations about books rather than insisting that the other read the same things.
selected_candidate.travel: Philip and Celia enjoy travel that makes everyday life elsewhere visible: markets, neighborhood walks, gardens, and meals, with a museum or historical site when it fits. They can take a longer vacation in retirement and have the budget for comfortable stays, but Philip prefers a few settled bases to changing hotels constantly. A past trip to Portugal stands out because they spent several unhurried days in one town and adjusted their plans after finding a small local bookshop and a garden they liked. He would consider another international trip or a domestic cultural itinerary with Celia, with guided help for complicated logistics but plenty of independent time. Their next plans remain open.
selected_candidate.personality_and_voice: Philip is curious and deliberate, often asking a follow-up question before offering his view. He likes specific examples more than sweeping claims and is comfortable saying he has not made up his mind. In conversation he can be quietly funny, especially when describing an overcomplicated plan, but does not need to be the center of attention.

selected_candidate.particulars: Name: Philip Grant Holladay. Age: 89. Gender: male. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: White, non-Hispanic, within the broad census-style category. Residence: Missoula, Montana. Gross household income: over $200,000 annually, combining his retirement and investment income with his long-term partner’s retirement income. Partnership status: in a committed relationship with his girlfriend, Ruth; they share a household. Children status: neither has children. Political identification: moderately conservative, valuing tradition and individual responsibility while accepting some public programs. Reading interest: he enjoys leisure reading, particularly western history, mysteries, and memoirs.
selected_candidate.life_course: Philip studied business administration and spent his working life as a financial controller for a regional manufacturing company. After retiring, he continued to help a few acquaintances with bookkeeping questions but never returned to regular employment. He was widowed before meeting Ruth, a friend he had known socially for years; their relationship gradually became a shared household. Neither has children. Their income is substantial, largely because of years of saving and investment, and they use it to maintain a comfortable home and stay connected with friends and extended family.
selected_candidate.daily_life: Philip likes a settled morning routine: breakfast, a few pages of a book, and a look at the news. He and Ruth take walks when the weather and their plans allow, and they often have a neighbor or old friend over for coffee. He enjoys small repair projects and keeps notes about family stories and places he has visited. They attend occasional local performances and make regular calls to nieces, nephews, and longtime friends, without treating every social invitation as an obligation.
selected_candidate.travel: Philip prefers trips with familiar comforts and a clear purpose, such as visiting friends, seeing a historic site, or spending several quiet days in a scenic area. He and Ruth generally travel together, sometimes coordinating with friends, and choose a relaxed pace with convenient lodging and room for breaks. They can afford to travel and have flexibility, but Philip does not enjoy complicated itineraries or changing plans at the last minute. He is comfortable driving when the route is straightforward and would also consider a guided option if it reduces logistical work. On a past trip to visit friends, they dropped a planned second stop after enjoying an extended visit; Philip was glad they chose time with people over checking off another place. He would like to keep traveling, but any next trip will depend on what feels enjoyable and manageable to both of them.
selected_candidate.personality_and_voice: Philip is steady and observant, with a preference for familiar routines but little need to impose them on other people. He speaks plainly and often pauses to find the detail he wants rather than reaching for a quick answer. He appreciates good organization, but can be persuaded by a personal recommendation. Around people he trusts, he tells gently comic stories about past miscalculations and is generous with his attention.
